name: Akhila Bhargavan
bio: Akhila Bhargavan is an actress working primarily in Malayalam films. She made her debute in her acting career through the short film Anurag Engineering Works and she made her debut in the malayalam movie Poovan

credits.title: Avaraachan & Sons
credits.overview: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

credits.title: It's a Medical Miracle
credits.overview: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

credits.title: Sookshmadarshini
credits.overview: Manuel returns with his mother to their former home in a middle-class neighbourhood. Suspicious of his intentions, Priyadarshini and her friends begin gathering clues, convinced he may be hiding something sinister.

credits.title: Premalu
credits.overview: Sachin, a carefree graduate, crosses paths with Reenu, a spirited IT professional, in Hyderabad. As their friendship deepens, unspoken feelings, career ambitions and life choices challenge their bond.

credits.title: Ayalvaashi
credits.overview: A petty misunderstanding changes Thajudheen and Benny's relationship from friends to foes. Thajudheen goes above and beyond to prove his innocence but ends up making things worse for his loved ones.

credits.title: Poovan
credits.overview: The day to day life of Hari, who suffers from sleeplessness, takes a turnaround with the arrival of a rooster next door.

credits.title: Anurag Engineering Works
credits.overview: A small town love story. The boy, a workshop owner - Anurag, in search for love and the girl - Neethu, who just wants to get by with her normal life. Anurag Engineering work takes us through their short fun filled journey.
